cases.name: read-empty-file-path
cases.why: 空串 file_path 是假值：与缺参同样报错

cases.name: read-path-fallback
cases.why: 空串 file_path 回退到 path（对齐 `input.file_path || input.path`）

cases.name: read-basic
cases.why: 行号 `N|text`，按 \n 切分保留末尾空行

cases.name: read-offset-limit
cases.why: offset 是 1-based 行号：offset=2/limit=2 展示第 2-3 行
cases.expected:
2|b
3|c

cases.name: read-offset-zero
cases.why: offset=0 与缺省一样从第一行开始（历史兼容：0/1 都映射到第一行）
cases.expected:
1|a
(Showing lines 1-1 of 4. Use offset=2 to continue.)

cases.name: read-offset-beyond-eof
cases.why: offset 超过总行数：输出为空、不追加续读 footer
